ctx.x: kid's way who had caused the accident. He was a Pennsylvania boy, you know. Well, I just surmised that those people are dead, those grown-ups and the kids, nothing you could do about them, and they just... These people lived somewhere out in the Midwest. So I imagine this boy, with the proper amount of money, just walked away clean from the whole thing.

But that was quite an experience, and it ended my days with Dakota Staton. It wasn't long after that, that I got a call from Gloria Lynne. I had an engagement with her in California. This turned out to be a rather strange kind of engagement, because I don't know what happened out there, but Gloria's behavior was very erratic. The club started off with people just loving her to death, the business was good, the place was packed and everything. But I never did understand quite what happened out there. After about…
